repaired_evidence_spans.snippet: The 8-bit Pointer Register of the devices is used to address a given data register.
Power-up reset value of P1/P0 is 00.
The Temperature Register of the TMP105 is a 12-bit, read-only register that stores the output of the most recent conversion.
The power-up/reset value of the Configuration Register is all bits equal to 0.
The TMP105 features one address pin allowing up to two devices to be connected per bus.
Data format for temperature is summarized in Table 5.
If the second byte is 00000110, the TMP105 will latch the status of the address pin and reset the internal registers to their power-up values.
